name: Draft Account Verification for eDebit Direct
author: eDebit Direct, LLC

sections.description:
eDebit Direct Draft adds a payment gateway to WooCommerce that allows merchants to accept Draft payments through the eDebit Direct payment service.

When a customer selects eDebit Direct Draft during WooCommerce checkout, the plugin creates a payment session with the eDebit Direct service. The customer is then redirected to the eDebit Direct hosted payment application to complete the payment process.

The plugin provides the WooCommerce integration and communicates with the eDebit Direct service. Payment processing, bank-account connectivity, account verification, and related downstream functionality are handled by eDebit Direct’s services.

The plugin does not directly integrate with DataX. Any DataX or other third-party bank-connectivity functionality used by eDebit Direct is managed by eDebit Direct and its service providers.

Key Features

  • WooCommerce Draft payment gateway integration.
  • Redirect customers to the eDebit Direct hosted payment application.
  • Secure communication with the eDebit Direct service over HTTPS.
  • WooCommerce order and customer information can be transmitted to eDebit Direct when a payment is initiated.
  • Supports WooCommerce checkout integration.
  • Supports WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.
  • Merchant configuration through WooCommerce payment settings.
  • Uses eDebit Direct API credentials configured by the merchant.
  • Payment result handling and WooCommerce order status updates.

External Service

This plugin communicates with the eDebit Direct service to create and process payment sessions.

The plugin communicates with the following eDebit Direct application:

https://app.edebitdirect.com/

The eDebit Direct service is used when a customer selects the eDebit Direct Draft payment method and initiates a payment.

During payment processing, the plugin may transmit information required to create and process the payment session. This may include:

  • WooCommerce order ID
  • Order amount
  • Customer first name
  • Customer last name
  • Customer email address
  • Customer phone number
  • Billing address
  • City
  • State
  • Country
  • ZIP/postal code
  • Payment method information required by the eDebit Direct service

After the payment session is created, the customer is redirected to the eDebit Direct hosted payment application to complete the payment process.

The eDebit Direct service may use third-party services for payment processing, bank connectivity, account verification, or related functionality. Such functionality is provided and managed by eDebit Direct and is not directly integrated into this WordPress plugin.

For more information about the eDebit Direct service, please visit:

https://edebitdirect.com/

Privacy Policy:

https://edebitdirect.com/privacy-policy/

Terms & Conditions:

https://edebitdirect.com/terms-conditions/

Privacy

When the eDebit Direct Draft payment method is used, the plugin sends information required to create and process the payment session to the eDebit Direct service.

The information transmitted may include customer, billing, order, and payment-session information as described in the External Service section.

The plugin does not directly connect to DataX. Any bank-account verification or connectivity services used by eDebit Direct are handled by eDebit Direct.

Merchants should review the eDebit Direct Privacy Policy and their own website privacy requirements before enabling the payment gateway.

eDebit Direct Privacy Policy:

https://edebitdirect.com/privacy-policy/

Requirements

The plugin requires:

  • WordPress 6.4 or later.
  • WooCommerce.
  • PHP 8.0 or later.
  • PHP cURL extension.
  • An active eDebit Direct merchant account.
  • Valid eDebit Direct API credentials.

The minimum PHP version should be verified against the PHP versions supported and tested by the merchant before installation.

Configuration

After activating the plugin:

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  2. Select eDebit Direct Draft.
  3. Enable the payment method.
  4. Enter the API credentials provided by eDebit Direct.
  5. Configure the available gateway options.
  6. Save the settings.

An active eDebit Direct merchant account and valid API credentials are required.

How It Works

  1. The customer adds products to the WooCommerce cart.
  2. The customer proceeds to WooCommerce checkout.
  3. The customer selects eDebit Direct Draft as the payment method.
  4. The plugin collects the information required to create the payment session.
  5. The plugin communicates with the eDebit Direct service.
  6. eDebit Direct creates the payment session.
  7. The customer is redirected to the eDebit Direct hosted payment application.
  8. The customer completes the payment process through the eDebit Direct application.
  9. The payment result is returned to the WooCommerce store.
  10. The WooCommerce order is updated according to the payment result.

Support

eDebit Direct provides support for merchant account setup, API credentials, payment processing, and plugin installation.

For support, contact:

Email: support@edebitdirect.com

Phone: 888-616-2535

Support hours:

7:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday.

For information about eDebit Direct:

https://edebitdirect.com/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Download the eDebit Direct Draft plugin ZIP file.
  3. Log in to the WordPress administration area.
  4. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  5. Click Upload Plugin.
  6. Select the plugin ZIP file.
  7. Click Install Now.
  8. Activate the plugin.
  9. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  10. Locate eDebit Direct Draft.
  11. Enable the payment method.
  12. Enter the API credentials provided by eDebit Direct.
  13. Configure the available payment gateway settings.
  14. Save the settings.
  15. Perform a test transaction before enabling the gateway for production payments.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an eDebit Direct account?

Yes. An active eDebit Direct merchant account and valid API credentials are required.

Does this plugin connect directly to DataX?

No. The WordPress plugin communicates with the eDebit Direct service. Any DataX or other bank-connectivity functionality is handled by eDebit Direct’s systems and service providers.

Where does the customer complete the payment?

The customer is redirected to the eDebit Direct hosted payment application to complete the payment process.

Does the plugin send customer information to eDebit Direct?

Yes. Information required to create and process the payment session may be transmitted to eDebit Direct. See the External Service section for details.

Does the plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Does the plugin support WooCommerce Checkout Blocks?

Yes. The plugin includes WooCommerce Checkout Blocks integration.

Does the plugin support refunds through WooCommerce?

Refunds are not processed through the WooCommerce payment gateway. Refund processing should be handled through the eDebit Direct service according to the merchant’s account and refund procedures.
